parsed.name: CVD气体与温度控制面板
parsed.description: 用于化学气相沉积（CVD）实验的控制面板，可管理三路反应气体的流量随时间变化曲线，并设置反应温度设定点；支持将参数保存为“配方”，并可开启/停止运行。
parsed.description_en: A control panel for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) experiments, used to manage time-varying flow profiles for three process gases and set a temperature setpoint; it supports saving/loading recipes and starting/stopping runs.

actions.description: 返回界面中用于配置的各项字段内容。
actions.description_en: Return the UI fields used for configuration.

actions.description: 将当前界面参数保存为配方文件（含元数据与气体设置），并选择保存位置。
actions.description_en: Save the current parameters as a recipe file (including metadata and gas settings) and prompt for the save path.

actions.description: 从配方文件中读取参数并填充到界面中，同时显示配方元数据并设置气体列标签。
actions.description_en: Load parameters from a recipe file into the interface, display recipe metadata, and set the gas column labels.

actions.description: 更新三路气体流量的曲线显示，用于反映随时间变化的趋势。
actions.description_en: Update the plots for the three gas flow curves to reflect the time evolution.

actions.description: 根据当前配方启动运行，并开始更新曲线与界面中的运行状态。
actions.description_en: Start the process according to the current recipe and begin updating the curves and run status.

actions.description: 应用温度设定点等参数到界面显示/对应控制项。
actions.description_en: Apply setpoints such as the temperature value to the relevant control items and UI display.
